site.title: Unofficial Grab’s Hardest
site.intro: Grab has a ridiculous number of challenge maps and everybody has a different idea of which one is the worst. This is our list. We look at how many people who tried a map actually beat it, how long it takes, and how many checkpoints it gives you, then argue about the order. Nothing to do with Grab itself.
site.foot1: How difficulty works: each map gets a number out of 10 from three things, how few checkpoints it has, how few players beat it, and how long it takes. A 10/10 would be no checkpoints, an hour or more to beat, and nobody finishing it. The order on the page is still set by hand.
site.foot2: Fan project. The maps and pictures belong to the people who made them, and to Grab.
site.playersIntro: Beat a map, take its points. The harder the map, the more it is worth, so this list shuffles every time someone clears something nasty.
